ledger.quote: We're holding the signature until the integration backlog is cleared — that's the one blocker on our side.

ledger.claim: The 2026-03-01 price increase applied to 41 enterprise accounts; 39 of them renewed on schedule.

ledger.quote: The promotional pricing is available exclusively to customers in the APAC region through the end of Q2.

ledger.claim: Difference-in-differences against 6 matched enterprise accounts gives -9,000,000 INR; the real effect is more extreme than all 6 placebo assignments.
